# Part A - Cohort and outcome definition (required)

## A1) Analytic cohort

```{r}
n0 <- nrow(nhanes_raw) # initial n 

nhanes_age50 <- nhanes_raw %>%
  filter(RIDAGEYR >= 50)

n1 <- nrow(nhanes_age50) # after age n 

nhanes <- nhanes_age50 %>%
  filter(!is.na(DXXNKBMD))

N <- nrow(nhanes) # final N 

flow_table <- tibble(
  step = c(
    "Initial sample (NHANES 2017-2018)",
    "Excluded: Age < 50",
    "Remaining after age restriction",
    "Excluded: Missing femoral neck BMD",
    "Final analytic cohort (age >= 50 & non-missing BMD)"
  ),
  n = c(
    n0,
    n0 - n1,
    n1,
    n1 - N,
    N
  )
)
print(flow_table) 
```

## A2) Compute femoral neck T‑score

The following formula was used to calculate the femoral neck T-score:

$$
\text{T-score}=
\frac{\text{BMD}_{\text{participant}} - \text{mean BMD}_{\text{reference}}}
{\text{SD}_{\text{reference}}}
$$

where $\text{BMD}_{\text{participant}}$ represents the observed femoral neck bone mineral density (BMD) of the participant, $\text{mean BMD}_{\text{reference}}$ represents the average peak femoral neck BMD of the reference population, and $\text{SD}_{\text{reference}}$ represents the standard deviation of the peak femoral neck BMD in the reference population.

The reference values were derived from the NHANES III young adult reference population adopted by the World Health Organization:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\text{mean BMD}_{\text{reference}} &= 0.858\ \text{g/cm}^2 \\
\text{SD}_{\text{reference}} &= 0.120\ \text{g/cm}^2
\end{aligned}
$$

```{r}
mean_bmd_ref <- 0.858
sd_bmd_ref   <- 0.120

nhanes <- nhanes %>%
  mutate(
    t_score = (DXXNKBMD - mean_bmd_ref) / sd_bmd_ref
  )
```

## A3) Define osteoporosis status (multiclass)

```{r}
nhanes <- nhanes %>%
  mutate(
    osteoporosis_status = case_when(
      t_score >= -1.0 ~ "Normal",
      t_score < -1.0 & t_score > -2.5 ~ "Osteopenia",
      t_score <= -2.5 ~ "Osteoporosis",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    osteoporosis_status = factor(
      osteoporosis_status,
      levels = c("Normal", "Osteopenia", "Osteoporosis")
    )
  )

# overall prevalence 
prev_all <- nhanes %>%
  count(osteoporosis_status, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prevalence = n / total
  )
print(prev_all)

# by sex 
prev_sex <- nhanes %>%
  group_by(gender, osteoporosis_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prevalence = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
print(prev_sex)

# by race/ethnicity
prev_race <- nhanes %>%
  group_by(race, osteoporosis_status) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop_last") %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(n),
    prevalence = n / total
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
print(prev_race)
```

```{r}
nhanes <- nhanes %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = factor(gender, levels = c(0, 1), 
                    labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Race = factor(race, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), 
                  labels = c("Hispanic", "White", "Black", "Asian", "Multi-racial")),
    osteoporosis_status = factor(osteoporosis_status, 
                                 levels = c("Normal", "Osteopenia", "Osteoporosis"))
  )

wilson_ci <- function(x, n, z = 1.96) {
  if (n == 0) return(c(NA_real_, NA_real_))
  p <- x / n
  denom <- 1 + z^2 / n
  center <- (p + z^2 / (2 * n)) / denom
  half <- z * sqrt((p * (1 - p) + z^2 / (4 * n)) / n) / denom
  c(center - half, center + half)
}

prev <- function(dat, group_var = NULL) {
  if (is.null(group_var)) {
    dat %>%
      count(osteoporosis_status, name = "n") %>%
      mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        p = n / total,
        lo = wilson_ci(n, total)[1],
        hi = wilson_ci(n, total)[2]
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
  } else {
    dat %>%
      group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
      count(osteoporosis_status, name = "n") %>%
      group_by(.data[[group_var]]) %>%
      mutate(total = sum(n)) %>%
      rowwise() %>%
      mutate(
        p = n / total,
        lo = wilson_ci(n, total)[1],
        hi = wilson_ci(n, total)[2]
      ) %>%
      ungroup() %>%
      rename(group = !!group_var)
  }
}
```

# Part C - Multiclass modeling (required)

```{r}
set.seed(123)

pal <- c("Normal" = "#00BA38", "Osteopenia" = "#619CFF", "Osteoporosis" = "#F8766D")

dat0 <- nhanes %>%
  mutate(
    Gender = factor(gender, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    Race = factor(race, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4), 
                  labels = c("Hispanic", "White", "Black", "Asian", "Multi-racial")),
    Education = factor(edu, levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3, 4),
                       labels = c("Advanced degree", "Less than HS", 
                                  "High school", "Some college/AA", "College graduate+")),
    PhysicalActivity = factor(phyac, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Inactive", "Active")),
    Alcohol = factor(alcol, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Smoking = factor(smkstat, levels = c(0, 1, 2), labels = c("Never", "Former", "Current")),
    Menopause = factor(meno, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Pre/Peri", "Post")),
    FractureHx = factor(fx, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    RheumatoidArthritis = factor(rheu, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    ThyroidDisease = factor(thyroid, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    HRT = factor(hrt, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    Pregnancy = factor(pregnan, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    y = factor(osteoporosis_status, levels = c("Normal", "Osteopenia", "Osteoporosis"))
  )

predictors_full <- c(
  "RIDAGEYR", "Gender", "Race",
  "BMXWT", "BMXHT", "BMXBMI", "BMXWAIST",
  "PhysicalActivity", "Alcohol", "Smoking",
  "Menopause", "FractureHx", "RheumatoidArthritis", "ThyroidDisease",
  "HRT", "Pregnancy",
  "Education", "INDFMPIR"
)

predictors_nosdoh <- setdiff(predictors_full, c("Education", "INDFMPIR"))

keep_cols_full <- c("y", predictors_full)
keep_cols_nosdoh <- c("y", predictors_nosdoh)

dat_full <- dat0 %>%
  select(all_of(keep_cols_full)) %>%
  drop_na()

dat_nosdoh <- dat0 %>%
  select(all_of(keep_cols_nosdoh)) %>%
  drop_na()

make_cv_folds <- function(y, k = 5, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  createFolds(y, k = k, returnTrain = FALSE)
}

macro_f1 <- function(cm) {
  diagv <- diag(cm)
  prec <- diagv / pmax(colSums(cm), 1)
  rec <- diagv / pmax(rowSums(cm), 1)
  f1 <- 2 * prec * rec / pmax(prec + rec, 1e-12)
  mean(f1, na.rm = TRUE)
}

balanced_acc <- function(cm) {
  rec <- diag(cm) / pmax(rowSums(cm), 1)
  mean(rec, na.rm = TRUE)
}

eval_from_preds <- function(y_true, y_pred, levs) {
  y_true <- factor(y_true, levels = levs)
  y_pred <- factor(y_pred, levels = levs)
  cm <- table(y_true, y_pred)
  list(
    cm = cm,
    acc = sum(diag(cm)) / sum(cm),
    macro_f1 = macro_f1(cm),
    bal_acc = balanced_acc(cm)
  )
}

cv_multinom <- function(dat, k = 5, seed = 123, maxit = 100) {
  levs <- levels(dat$y)
  folds <- make_cv_folds(dat$y, k = k, seed = seed)
  preds <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))
  probs <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(dat), length(levs))
  colnames(probs) <- levs
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    te <- folds[[i]]
    tr <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(dat)), te)
    fit <- multinom(y ~ ., data = dat[tr, ], trace = FALSE, maxit = maxit)
    pprob <- predict(fit, newdata = dat[te, ], type = "probs")
    if (is.vector(pprob)) {
      tmp <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(te), ncol = length(levs))
      colnames(tmp) <- levs
      cls <- colnames(pprob)
      tmp[, cls] <- pprob
      pprob <- tmp
    } else {
      pprob <- as.matrix(pprob)
      pprob <- pprob[, levs, drop = FALSE]
    }
    preds[te] <- levs[max.col(pprob, ties.method = "first")]
    probs[te, ] <- pprob
  }
  out <- eval_from_preds(dat$y, preds, levs)
  out$pred <- factor(preds, levels = levs)
  out$prob <- probs
  out
}

cv_rf <- function(dat, k = 5, seed = 123, num.trees = 500, mtry = NULL, min.node.size = 5) {
  levs <- levels(dat$y)
  folds <- make_cv_folds(dat$y, k = k, seed = seed)
  preds <- rep(NA_character_, nrow(dat))
  probs <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow(dat), length(levs))
  colnames(probs) <- levs
  for (i in seq_along(folds)) {
    te <- folds[[i]]
    tr <- setdiff(seq_len(nrow(dat)), te)
    fit <- ranger(
      y ~ .,
      data = dat[tr, ],
      probability = TRUE,
      num.trees = num.trees,
      mtry = mtry,
      min.node.size = min.node.size,
      seed = seed + i
    )
    pprob <- predict(fit, dat[te, ])$predictions
    pprob <- pprob[, levs, drop = FALSE]
    preds[te] <- levs[max.col(pprob, ties.method = "first")]
    probs[te, ] <- pprob
  }
  out <- eval_from_preds(dat$y, preds, levs)
  out$pred <- factor(preds, levels = levs)
  out$prob <- probs
  out
}

res_multinom_full <- cv_multinom(dat_full, k = 5, seed = 123)
res_multinom_nosdoh <- cv_multinom(dat_nosdoh, k = 5, seed = 123)

res_rf_full <- cv_rf(dat_full, k = 5, seed = 123, num.trees = 500, min.node.size = 5)
res_rf_nosdoh <- cv_rf(dat_nosdoh, k = 5, seed = 123, num.trees = 500, min.node.size = 5)

perf <- tibble(
  model = c("Multinomial LR (Full)", "Multinomial LR (No SDoH)", 
            "RF (Full)", "RF (No SDoH)"),
  accuracy = c(res_multinom_full$acc, res_multinom_nosdoh$acc, 
               res_rf_full$acc, res_rf_nosdoh$acc),
  macro_f1 = c(res_multinom_full$macro_f1, res_multinom_nosdoh$macro_f1, 
               res_rf_full$macro_f1, res_rf_nosdoh$macro_f1),
  balanced_accuracy = c(res_multinom_full$bal_acc, res_multinom_nosdoh$bal_acc, 
                        res_rf_full$bal_acc, res_rf_nosdoh$bal_acc)
)
print(perf)

cat("\nMultinomial LR (Full) confusion matrix:\n")
print(res_multinom_full$cm)

cat("\nMultinomial LR (No SDoH) confusion matrix:\n")
print(res_multinom_nosdoh$cm)

cat("\nRandom Forest (Full) confusion matrix:\n")
print(res_rf_full$cm)

cat("\nRandom Forest (No SDoH) confusion matrix:\n")
print(res_rf_nosdoh$cm)

fit_rf_final <- ranger(
  y ~ .,
  data = dat_full,
  probability = TRUE,
  num.trees = 500,
  min.node.size = 5,
  seed = 123
)

X_full <- dat_full %>% select(-y)
y_full <- dat_full$y
levs <- levels(y_full)

set.seed(123)
idx_shap <- sample(seq_len(nrow(X_full)), size = min(400, nrow(X_full)))
X_shap <- X_full[idx_shap, , drop = FALSE]

pred_fun_class <- function(cls) {
  function(object, newdata) {
    p <- predict(object, data = newdata)$predictions
    as.numeric(p[, cls])
  }
}

set.seed(123)
sh_list <- lapply(levs, function(cls) {
  explain(
    object = fit_rf_final,
    X = X_shap,
    pred_wrapper = pred_fun_class(cls),
    nsim = 10,
    adjust = TRUE
  )
})
names(sh_list) <- levs

sh_abs_by_class <- lapply(sh_list, function(m) colMeans(abs(m), na.rm = TRUE))
sh_abs_mat <- do.call(cbind, sh_abs_by_class)
sh_mean <- rowMeans(sh_abs_mat)

sh_tbl <- tibble(
  feature = names(sh_mean),
  value = as.numeric(sh_mean)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(value))

p_shap <- ggplot(sh_tbl, aes(x = reorder(feature, value), y = value)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.75) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "SHAP",
    title = "Random Forest SHAP: Feature Importance (All Predictors)"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 12)
```

# Part D - Missing data and reproducibility (required)

```{r}
vars_model <- c(
  "RIDAGEYR", "Gender", "Race",
  "BMXWT", "BMXHT", "BMXBMI", "BMXWAIST",
  "PhysicalActivity", "Alcohol", "Smoking",
  "Menopause", "FractureHx", "RheumatoidArthritis", "ThyroidDisease",
  "HRT", "Pregnancy",
  "Education", "INDFMPIR"
)

missing_summary <- dat0 %>%
  select(all_of(vars_model)) %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    ~ sum(is.na(.)),
    .names = "n_missing_{.col}"
  )) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "variable",
    values_to = "n_missing"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    variable = sub("^n_missing_", "", variable),
    pct_missing = n_missing / nrow(dat0) * 100
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(pct_missing))

print(missing_summary)
```
